blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: LLMs are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in social environments, making it critical to study their ability to faithfully simulate human interactions. Central to this is grounding agents in realistic user personas, yet existing datasets rely on fictional personas and are limited to a handful of languages, lacking the empirical grounding necessary to evaluate behavioral fidelity across diverse populations. We introduce Wiki-Talkie, a multilingual dataset of real-world conversations from Wikipedia Talk pages across five languages spanning two language families: Germanic (German, English) and Romance (Spanish, French, Italian), paired with personas derived from real user communities and encompassing sociodemographic attributes, self-descriptions, and behaviorally grounded interaction traits. Using Wiki-Talkie, we evaluate agent interactional behavior on a next-turn generation task across various persona conditioning strategies. Our evaluation assesses whether agents collectively reproduce the distributional behavioral patterns observed in human discussions. Results show that user’s comment history exemplifying interaction behavior consistently outperforms explicit persona information. In addition, models systematically underproduce negative or extreme sentiments, while over producing references and suggestions, revealing biases toward agreeableness and positivity. Crucially, these patterns hold robustly across languages, with small cross-lingual differences. 1 1 1 Code and data are available at https://github.com/amazon-science/wikitalkie .
blocks.zh: 有限责任公司越来越多地作为自主代理人在社会环境中部署,因此,研究其忠实模拟人类互动的能力至关重要。 这一点的核心在于将实际用户人作为基础,但现有的数据集依赖于虚构的人物,并且仅限于少数语言,缺乏评价不同人群行为忠诚性所必需的经验基础。 我们介绍维基百科Talkie(维基百科Talk)的多语种对话数据集, 使用Wiki-Talkie,我们评价代理交互行为,在下一个回合的生成任务中,通过各种人物调节策略. 我们的评价评估了代理人是否集体复制了人类讨论中观察到的分布行为模式. 结果显示,用户的评论历史表明互动行为的表现始终高于明确的人的信息。 此外,模型系统地造成消极或极端情绪的低落,而过多地产生参考和建议,显示出对可接受性和客观性的偏见。 关键是,这些模式在各种语言之间牢牢地保持,具有小的跨语言差异. 1 1 代码和数据见https://github.com/amazon-science/wikitalkeie。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded in real-world social systems, from community moderation on Reddit 2 2 2 https://redditinc.com/news/oterlu-team-joins-reddit-to-accelerate-safety-efforts . to experimental platforms like MoltBook 3 3 3 https://www.moltbook.com . where LLMs autonomously interact at scale. These developments position LLMs not merely as tools, but as agents : autonomous actors participating in governance, culture, and social interaction.
Central to the design of such agents is the role they are asked to play ( Shanahan et al., 2023 ; Tseng et al., 2024 ) , e.g. the persona , that is, a composite of individual traits such as background facts, language behavior, and interaction style ( Liu et al., 2025a ) . This approach has been shown to improve alignment with real human populations in applications such as personalized dialogues ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , linguistic annotation ( Orlikowski et al., 2025 ) , and social simulations ( Argyle et al., 2023 ; Park et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
从Reddit 2 2 2 https://redditinc.com/news/oterlu-team-joins-reddit-to-acelate-security-efforts上的社区节制,大语言模型越来越多地嵌入现实社会体系中. . to MoltBook 3 3 3 https://www.moltbook.com. LLMs在规模上自主互动的实验平台. 这些发展不仅将地方政府作为工具,而且作为行为者:参与治理、文化和社会互动的自主行为者。
这类物剂设计的核心是被要求扮演的角色(Shanahan等人,2023年;Tseng等人,2024年),例如人物,即背景事实,语言行为,互动风格等个人特征的复合体(Liu等人,2025年a). 事实证明,这种方法在诸如个性化对话(Liu等人,2025年a),语言注释(Orlikowski等人,2025年)和社会模拟等应用方面与实际人口更加一致。 (Argyle等人,2023年;Park等人,2024年).

blocks.en:
However, existing datasets for modeling persona-based conversational agents rely on fictional personas ( Smith et al., 2020 ; Jang et al., 2022 ; Xu et al., 2022a ; Xu et al., 2022b ; Yamashita et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Lotfi et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2022 ; Occhipinti et al., 2024 ) , making it impossible to verify whether agent behavior faithfully reflects the opinions, linguistic patterns, and interaction dynamics of the actual human population being simulated.
Datasets extracting personas from large-scale media ( Zheng et al., 2020 ; Wu et al., 2021 ) offer greater realism but are limited to Chinese or English. To our best knowledge, there is no resource providing real-world, multilingual dialogues grounded in real personas within a cooperative setting where pragmatic phenomena such as conflict, misalignment, and evolving viewpoints can emerge—precisely the dynamics that characterize high-stakes scenarios.
blocks.zh:
然而,用于模拟个人对话代理的现有数据集依赖于虚构人物(Smith等人,2020年;Jang等人,2022年;Xu等人,2022年a; 徐等人,2022b;山下等人,2023年;赵等人,2025年;洛特菲等人,2023年;陈等人,2022年;奥西平蒂等人,2024年),使得无法验证代理行为是否忠实地反映了模拟中的实际人类种群的意见,语言规律,互动动态.
从大型媒体提取人物的数据集 (郑等. 2020; Wu et al., 2021) 提供更大的现实主义,但仅限于中文或英文. 据我们所知,没有一个资源能够提供现实世界、多语种对话,而这种对话是以真正的人为基础,在合作环境中,冲突、错位和不断变化的观点等务实现象可能会出现,而这正是高调情景的特点。

blocks.en:
To fill this gap, we introduce Wiki-Talkie , a multilingual dataset of real-world discussions extracted from Wikipedia Talk pages across five languages, where registered users collaboratively deliberate on article edits. Wiki-Talkie enables multifaceted evaluation of agents in a consensus-oriented discussion scenario, with optional conditioning on personas derived from Wikipedia user pages, and behavioral traits from comment histories.
To safeguard user privacy, all identities are anonymized and persona profiles are regenerated in a neutral fashion rather than verbatim copies, ensuring privacy protection while maintaining research utility.
blocks.zh:
为了填补这一空白,我们引入了Wiki-Talkie,这是从维基百科Talk页面中提取的五种语言的现实世界讨论的多语种数据集,注册用户在文章编辑上合作审议. Wiki-Talkie在以共识为导向的讨论情景下,
为了保障用户隐私,所有身份都被匿名化,人物简介以中性方式而非逐字记录形式重新生成,确保隐私保护,同时保持研究效用。

blocks.en:
Our evaluation targets what we term population fidelity : whether agents collectively reproduce the distributional behavioral patterns observed in human discussions, as opposed to individual-level persona fidelity , i.e., whether a single generated response faithfully reflects the provided persona of a specific user. This choice is principled: individual-level fidelity risks enabling faithful simulation of specific individuals, raising ethical concerns around impersonation and lack of consent ( Desai et al., 2025 ) , while population fidelity is more tractable and more relevant for applications such as community simulation and policy analysis. This aligns with an emerging consensus that evaluation of persona-based agents should operate at the population level ( Mansour et al., 2025 ; Rupprecht et al., 2025 ; Fawaz et al., 2026 ) . To assess population fidelity, we frame
the task as next-turn generation : given a thread of previous comments, an agent must generate the next comment simulating a specific Wikipedia editor. We conduct evaluations with multiple metrics: instance-level text similarity (ROUGE-L and BERTScore), which provides individual-level signals averaged across the entire dataset, and population-level interactional behavior, comparing sentiment and dialog act distributions ( Searle, 1969 ) between human comments and those generated by agents powered by multiple state-of-the-art LLMs, across five languages.
We study how agents behave when conditioned on different types of persona information, comparing behavioral traits extracted from comment histories against explicit persona descriptions derived from user profiles. Results show that cross-lingual differences are small, consistent with prior work on multilingual LLM evaluation showing strong performance across high-resource languages Xuan et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2025) . We also find that comment history consistently proves more effective than explicit persona information as a conditioning strategy, suggesting that showing how a persona behaves outperforms telling what a persona is.
blocks.zh:
我们的评价针对的是我们所说的"人口忠诚": 代理人是否集体复制了人类讨论中观察到的分布行为模式,而不是个人层面的忠诚,即单个生成的响应是否忠实地反映了特定用户提供的人的人格. 这种选择是原则性的:个人一级的忠诚有可能导致对具体个人进行忠实的模拟,引起对冒充和缺乏同意的道德关切(Desai等人,2025年),而人口忠诚则更具有吸引力,更适用于社区模拟和政策分析等应用。 这与新出现的共识是一致的,即应在人口一级评价以人为基础的物剂(Mansour等人,2025年;Rupprecht等人,2025年;Fawaz等人,2026年)。 为了评估人口的忠诚度,我们设定
作为下一回合生成的任务 : 考虑到先前评论的线索, 代理商必须生成下一个模拟特定维基百科编辑器的评论 。 我们用多种衡量标准进行评价:实例一级文本相似性(ROUGE-L和BERTScore),它提供整个数据集中平均的个人一级信号,以及人口一级互动行为,比较人类评论与由多种最新LLMs提供动力的代理人在五种语言之间产生的情感和对话行为分布(Searle,1969年)。
我们研究代理人在以不同类型的人物信息为条件时的行为方式,比较从评论历史中提取的行为特征和从用户简介中得出的显性人物描述。 结果显示,跨文化差异很小,与以往多语种LLM评价工作一致,显示高资源语言Xuan等人(2025年);Li等人(2025年)的业绩良好。 我们还发现,评论历史始终证明,比显性人的信息更有效,作为一种条件性策略,说明一个人的行为表现优于说明一个人是什么。

blocks.en: Overall, our contributions are: 1) the construction of Wiki-Talkie, a dataset of Wikipedia discussions supporting research on agentic interaction simulation, whose key advantages are: a) multilingual coverage; b) real-world discussions reflecting established communication norms; c) ground-truth persona information linked to discussions; and d) rich contextual information, with discussions paired with articles; 2) the evaluation of agents based on four LLMs under various conditioning strategies across five languages, providing insights into the limitations of current agentic simulation of human cooperative interactions.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,我们的贡献是: 1)构建维基百科讨论数据集:维基共享资源中支持代理互动模拟研究的数据集,其关键优势是:(a) 多语种覆盖;(b) 反映既定通信规范的现实世界讨论;(c) 与讨论相关的地面-真实人物信息;(d) 内容丰富的背景信息,讨论与文章结合;2) 在五种语言的各种调节策略下,基于四种LLMs的代理评估,为当前代理模拟人类合作互动的局限性提供了洞察.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Conversational datasets with persona-related attributes vary in source, language, and use case. Crowdsourced datasets dominate, exemplified by PersonaChat Zhang et al. (2018b) , where crowdworkers converse under fictional personas, and its many extensions: BlendedSkillTalk ( Smith et al., 2020 ) adds empathy and knowledge, FoCus ( Jang et al., 2022 ) adds Wikipedia grounding, Multi-Session Chat ( Xu et al., 2022a ) models longer-term interaction, DuLeMon ( Xu et al., 2022b ) uses Chinese mutual personas, and RealPersonaChat ( Yamashita et al., 2023 ) collects real persona descriptions in Japanese. Other datasets rely on synthetic generation ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Lotfi et al., 2023 ) or scripted content ( Chen et al., 2022 ; Occhipinti et al., 2024 ) , while social media datasets such as PersonalDialog ( Zheng et al., 2020 ) and PER-CHAT ( Wu et al., 2021 ) extract persona signals from large-scale platforms. Most rely on simulated role-play or synthetic generation and cover few languages: although XPersona ( Lin et al., 2021 ) extends PersonaChat multilingually via automatic translation, naturally occurring interaction datasets remain largely restricted to English and Chinese. Critically, no existing resource simultaneously provides: (i) naturally occurring dialogues, (ii) multilingual coverage, (iii) real user-derived personas linked to the conversations, and (iv) a cooperative yet contentious setting where disagreement, negotiation, and consensus-building emerge. We address this gap with Wiki-Talkie.
blocks.zh: 与人物相关属性的对话数据集在来源,语言,使用大小写上各不相同. 以PersonaChat Zhang等人(2018年b)为例, 人群工作者在虚构的人格下交谈, BlendedSkillTalk(Smith等人,2020年)增加了同情心和知识,FoCus(Jang等人,2022年)增加了维基百科的定位,多会聊天(徐等人,2022a年)模型长期互动,DuLeMon(徐等人,2022b年)使用了中国的共性,RealPersonaChat(Yamashita等人,2023年)收集了日语中真实的人性描述. 其他数据集依靠合成生成(赵.等人,2025年;洛特菲等人,2023年)或脚本内容(陈 al等人,2022年;奥西平蒂等人,2024年),而个人Dialog(郑 Zheng等人,2020年)和PER-CHAT(吴 Wu等人,2021年)等社交媒体数据集则从大型平台提取人物信号. 大部分依赖模拟角色扮演或合成生成,并覆盖少数语言:虽然XPersona(Lin等人,2021年)扩展Persona 通过自动翻译进行多语种聊天,自然发生的交互数据集基本上仍限于英语和中文. 关键的是,现有资源没有同时提供:(一) 自然对话,(二) 多语种报道,(三) 与对话有关联的真正用户,(四) 出现分歧、谈判和建立共识的合作性但有争议的环境。 我们用Wiki-Talkie来解决这个缺口。

blocks.en: A growing body of work documents systematic biases in LLM-generated social behavior. LLMs exhibit sycophantic tendencies, preferring agreement over truthful disagreement ( Malmqvist, 2025 ) , and display a positivity bias that suppresses negative or confrontational outputs ( Santurkar et al., 2023 ) . Studies using LLMs to simulate human populations have shown that, while persona conditioning can improve alignment with survey response distributions ( Argyle et al., 2023 ) , models often fail to reproduce the full diversity of human opinions and behaviors ( Orlikowski et al., 2025 ) . However, these findings are predominantly based on English-only settings, synthetic survey tasks, or opinion elicitation, leaving open the question of whether such biases persist in naturalistic, multilingual, cooperative discussions. Wiki-Talkie addresses this gap by providing a testbed where LLM social behavior can be evaluated against real human interactions across five languages in a collaborative setting with genuine disagreement and pragmatic complexity.
blocks.zh: 越来越多的工作文件对LLM产生的社会行为有系统偏见。 LLMS表现出了共鸣的倾向,倾向于达成协议而不是真诚的分歧(Malmqvist,2025年),并表现出压制消极或对抗性产出的偏执(Santurkar等人,2023年)。 使用LLMs模拟人类种群的研究表明,虽然人性调节可以改善与调查响应分布的配合(Argyle等人,2023年),但模型往往无法复制人类观点和行为的全面多样性(Orlikowski等人,2025年). 然而,这些调查结果主要基于仅以英语为主的环境、合成调查任务或意见征求,因此,在自然主义、多语种、合作性讨论中,这种偏见是否继续存在,尚存疑问。 Wiki-Talkie通过提供一个测试台来弥补这一差距,在这个测试台上,LLM社会行为可以在真正分歧和务实复杂性的协作环境中,对照人类在五种语言间的真正互动来评价LLM社会行为.

blocks.en: Wikipedia Talk pages remain underexplored despite providing large-scale, naturally occurring collaborative dialogue Johnson et al. (2024) . Prior work has used them to study conversational behavior and harmful interactions ( Wulczyn et al., 2017 ; Zhang et al., 2018a ) , dialogue act classification Ferschke et al. (2012) , dispute detection Wang and Cardie (2014) , sociolinguistics Prabhakaran and Rambow (2016) , abuse ( Cécillon et al., 2020 ) , and links between discussions and edit histories ( Jaidka et al., 2021 ) . WikiConv ( Hua et al., 2018 ) reconstructs full conversational histories including edits and deletions, supporting tasks such as preemptive toxicity detection ( Karan and Šnajder, 2019 ) . However, these datasets focus on discourse structure, conflict, or toxicity, remain mostly English-centric, and lack persistent persona representations for multilingual evaluation. To our knowledge, Talk pages have not been used to analyze LLM behavior in socially grounded, collaborative settings.
blocks.zh: 维基百科 尽管提供了大规模、自然发生的合作对话,但谈话页仍然没有得到充分利用。 之前的工作曾用它们来研究对话行为和有害的相互作用(Wulczyn等人,2017年;Zhang等人,2018a),对话行为分类. Ferschke等人(2012年),争议侦测王和嘉迪(2014年),社会语言学 Prabhakaran and Rambow(2016年),虐待(Cécillon等人,2020年),讨论与编辑历史之间的联系(Jaidka等人,2021年). 维基文库 (Hua等人,2018年) 重建完整的对话历史,包括编辑和删除,辅助任务如先发制人毒性检测(Karan和Šnajder,2019年). 然而,这些数据集侧重于讨论结构、冲突或毒性,仍然大多以英语为中心,而且缺乏用于多语种评价的持久人物表述。 据我们所知,Talk网页并没有被用来分析基于社会、合作环境中的LLM行为。

blocks.zh: 3 维基塔尔基语Name

blocks.en: Figure 1: Example from Wiki-Talkie with its three core components: article , thread , and persona .
blocks.zh: 图1:Wiki-Talkie的示例及其三个核心组成部分:文章、线索和人物。

blocks.en: We introduce Wiki-Talkie , a multilingual dataset of real-world discussions extracted from Wikipedia Talk pages across five languages spanning two language families: Germanic (German, English) and Romance (Spanish, French, Italian). Wiki-Talkie is built around three core components (see Figure 1 ): 1) multilingual threads in which users deliberate on article content; 2) user personas from two complementary sources, a self-reported profile derived from Wikipedia user pages (with attributes such as gender, profession, interests, and contribution topics) and behavioral traits inferred from each user’s comment history; and 3) the article context, paired with each thread as it appeared immediately before the discussion began. Together, these components make Wiki-Talkie suited for research on persona-conditioned and document-grounded interaction modeling across languages. 4 4 4 Examples are in Appendix B , Tables 6 – 10 .
blocks.zh: 我们介绍维基语系-塔尔基语系(Wiki-Talkie),这是从维基百科Talk页面中提取的多语种讨论数据集,涉及五种语言:德语(德语、英语)和罗曼语(西班牙语、法语、意大利语)。 维基-塔尔基环绕三个核心部分(见图1): 1) 用户考虑文章内容的多语言线程;2) 用户人物来自两个互补来源,一个自报自维基百科用户页面(包含性别,职业,兴趣,贡献主题等属性),以及从每个用户评论历史推断的行为特征;3) 文章上下文,与讨论开始前出现的每个线程对齐. 这些组件一起使得Wiki-Talkie适合研究个性化和基于文档的跨语言互动模型. 4 4 实例见附录B,表6-10。

blocks.en: Table 1 presents summary statistics of Wiki-Talkie across languages (full distributions in Appendix A.1.1 ). German contributes the largest portion (>42K threads, >134K turns), followed by French and English, while Spanish and Italian form smaller subsets. Despite differences in scale, structural characteristics are remarkably consistent across languages: threads contain on average 3.2--3.6 turns and involve 2.1--2.3 unique users. 5 5 5 These statistics are not necessarily representative of Wikipedia Talk pages at large, but reflect our construction pipeline (Section 3.1 ). Turn length varies more, ranging from 47.74 words (German) to 79.73 (Spanish), potentially reflecting differences in editorial culture or linguistic verbosity. High standard deviations across all metrics indicate substantial variability, consistent with discussions ranging from brief clarifications to extended debates. The number of unique users mirrors the thread distribution; further details on users and personas are in Appendix A.1.2 .
blocks.zh: 表1列出不同语言的维基语-塔尔基语的汇总统计数据(附录A.1.1中的完整分布)。 德语贡献最大(>42K线程,>134K转弯),其次是法语和英语,而西班牙语和意大利语则形成较小的子集. 尽管规模不同,但各种语言的结构特征非常一致:线程平均包含3.2-3.6个转弯,涉及2.1-2.3个独特的用户。 5 5 5 这些统计数据不一定代表整个维基百科Talk页面,而是反映了我们的构建管道(第3.1节)。 转动长度差异较大,从47.74字(德语)到79.73字(西班牙语)不等,可能反映出编辑文化或语言动词的差异. 所有衡量标准都存在高标准偏差,表明差异很大,这与从简短澄清到长期辩论的讨论是一致的。 独一无二的用户数量反映了线程分布;关于用户和人物的进一步详情见附录A.1.2.

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集建设

blocks.en:
The threads contained in Wiki-Talkie are extracted from raw Wikipedia Talk page dumps. 6 6 6 Dumps from October 2025: https://dumps.wikimedia.org/<lang_code>wiki/20251001/ . Wikipedia Talk pages are largely unstructured, making clean conversation extraction a challenging preprocessing task Ferschke et al. (2012) ; Hua et al. (2018) .
We exploit standard conventions: MediaWiki heading syntax for topics, username-timestamp signatures, and colon-based reply indentation, and handcrafted regular expressions to parse threads into flat sequential turns ordered by timestamps 7 7 7 See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Talk_page_guidelines . .
To address extraction errors, we prompted the extractor model to revise threads by correcting turn boundaries and comment attributions, flagging irrecoverable cases for exclusion (prompt reported in Appendix C , Figure 10 ).
blocks.zh:
维基百科中包含的线条摘自原始维基百科Talk页面垃圾堆. 6 6 2025年10月的垃圾堆:https://dumps.wikimedia.org/<lang_code>wiki/20251001/. 维基百科 谈话页基本没有结构,使得清洁的谈话提取成为费施克等人(2012年)的一项具有挑战性的预处理任务;Hua等人(2018年).
我们利用标准惯例: MediaWiki 标题语法用于主题,用户名-timestamp签名,以及以冒号为基础的回复缩进,手动将正则表达式解析为时间戳命令的平序转折 7 7 7 见https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Talk_page_guidelines.
为了解决提取错误,我们促使提取器模型修改线程,纠正转弯界限和评论归属,标出无法收回的排除情况(见附录C,图10)。

blocks.en:
For each unique user in the extracted threads, we fetched the corresponding Wikipedia user page via the MediaWiki API. 8 8 8 https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/API , accessed through mwclient ( https://github.com/mwclient/mwclient ). User pages are optional personal spaces where editors describe themselves, their interests, expertise, and contributions. We prompted the extractor model to determine whether a page contained relevant biographical or self-descriptive content, excluding pages consisting solely of administrative templates or userboxes (prompt in Appendix C , Figure 15 ). For pages with substantive content, the model also generated a natural-language profile summarizing all available details, following recent work on LLM-based persona extraction ( Zhang, 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Mansour et al., 2025 ) . Because these are self-declared attributes from real users, the resulting personas avoid the stereotypical or synthetic quality of artificially constructed profiles and naturally incorporate sociodemographic aspects, making them valuable for evaluating how such factors influence agent behavior and biases. Alongside the profile, the model extracted predefined attributes in JSON format (e.g., primary editing topics, gender, profession) to support statistical analysis of user subgroups. Users with successfully generated profiles were subsampled to at most 10,000 per language, prioritizing presence of contribution topics, then gender (favoring women and non-binary users to counteract imbalance), then profession.
Only threads where all participants belong to the selected subset were retained.
blocks.zh:
对于提取线程中每个独特的用户,我们通过MediaWiki API获取了相应的维基百科用户页面. 8 8 8 https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/API,通过mwclient访问(https://github.com/mwclient/mwclient.). 用户网页是编辑自我描述、兴趣、专门知识和贡献的可选个人空间。 我们促使提取器模型确定某一页是否包含相关的传记或自我描述内容,不包括仅由行政模板或用户框组成的页面(附录C,图15)。 对于具有实质性内容的网页,该模型还产生了一个自然语言简介,总结了最近关于LLM个人提取(Zhang, 2024;Wu等人, 2025;Mansour等人, 2025)的工作之后的所有现有细节。 因为这些是真实用户自告奋勇的属性,由此产生的人物避免了人为构筑的剖面图的陈规定型或合成质量,自然包含社会人口方面,使其对评价这些因素如何影响代理人行为和偏见很有价值。 除了配置外,该模型还提取了JSON格式的预定义属性(如主编辑专题,性别,专业),以支持用户分组的统计分析. 成功生成剖面图的用户被抽查到每个语言最多10 000个,优先考虑贡献专题的存在,然后是性别(有利于妇女和非二进制用户消除不平衡),然后是职业。
只保留了所有参与者属于选定子集的线程 。

blocks.en: From each user’s comments (across up to 50 randomly sampled threads), we extracted behavioral traits using the extractor model, characterizing each user along eight dimensions including (dis)agreement strategy and editing behavior. Each dimension is filled with closed response options only when sufficient evidence is available, accompanied by the model’s reasoning (prompts in Appendix C , Figures 11 – 13 ). Unlike self-declared profiles, these traits are inferred from concrete interactions, making them especially useful for evaluating how behavioral conditioning shapes agent output. A manual quality audit of profiles and traits (faithfulness, coherence, privacy preservation) is reported in Appendix I .
blocks.zh: 从每个用户的评论(最多50条随机抽取的线程)中,我们利用提取器模型提取了行为特征,按照8个维度描述每个用户的特征,包括(dis)协议策略和编辑行为. 每个维度只有在有充足证据时,加上模型的推理(附录C,图11 – 13中的提示),才填充闭塞响应选项. 与自述剖面图不同的是,这些特征是从具体相互作用中推断出来的,这使得它们特别有助于评价行为调节如何输出剂. 附录一报告了对概况和特征(诚信、一致性、隐私保护)的人工质量审计。

blocks.en: For each thread, the discussed Wikipedia article is retrieved via the MediaWiki API to provide conversational context, using the revision immediately preceding the first comment’s timestamp. This temporal alignment ensures the retrieved content reflects the article state when the discussion began.
blocks.zh: 对于每个线索,讨论过的维基百科文章通过MediaWiki API检索,以提供对话背景,使用第一评论时间戳前的修订版. 这种时间调整确保了检索的内容反映讨论开始时的文章状态.

blocks.en: Finally, all usernames are anonymized via deterministic hashing to prevent re-identification, and thread and article formatting is cleaned and normalized for consistency. Full details are in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: 最后,所有用户名都通过确定散列来进行匿名,以防止重新识别,对线条和文章格式进行清理,并规范一致性。 详细情况见附录A.2。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setting
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en:
Wiki-Talkie supports tasks including comment generation, summarization, and quality assessment. Here, we frame the task as next-turn generation : given the preceding comments in a thread, an agent is asked to generate the next comment in the role of the real user who authored it. We always condition on at least one preceding comment (i.e., the first turn is never generated
from scratch), and prior context always consists of ground-truth comments.
This task formulation was chosen deliberately to enable controlled, comparable evaluation across languages and conditioning strategies, resulting in over 100 experimental conditions (5 languages × \times 4 models × \times 5 conditioning methods).
Although Wiki-Talkie supports evaluation along several dimensions—including coherence with context, factual grounding in the associated article, and fidelity to persona conditioning—here we focus on interaction behavior of agents.
blocks.zh:
Wiki-Talkie支持任务包括评论生成,总结,和质量评估. 在此, 我们将此任务设定为下一回合的生成 : 考虑到前面在线索中的评论, 请代理生成作者角色中的下一个评论 。 我们总是以至少一个之前的评论为条件(即第一个转弯从不产生)
从头到尾),前上下文总是包括地面真实的评论。
这种任务配制是有意选择的,以便能进行控制下,可比较的跨语言的评价和调制策略,导致100多个实验条件(5种语言×\时4种模型×\时5种调制方法).
虽然Wiki-Talkie支持从几个方面来评价,包括与背景的一致性、相关文章中的事实依据和对人格条件的忠诚度,但我们在此侧重于代理人的互动行为。

blocks.en: To keep generation costs manageable, we experimented with a subsample of Wiki-Talkie. We selected threads involving users with at least six comments in the corpus, ensuring a minimum five-comment history prior to the target comment. From these, we sampled up to 5,000 threads per language, maximizing the proportion of comments authored by females up to 50%. Summary statistics are presented in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 为了控制生成成本 我们用维基塔基的子样本进行了实验 我们选择了涉及用户的线程,其中至少有6条评论内容,确保目标评论之前至少有5条评论历史. 从中,我们抽取了高达5000个线程每种语言,将女性撰写的评论比例最大化至50%. 附录D列出简要统计数字。

conditioning methods. Left: averages across models for each language. Right: averages across languages for each model.

blocks.en:
We defined five conditioning methods
to investigate how different types of persona information shape agent behavior in interactions: i) base role-play, where the agent is instructed that it is a Wikipedia editor with no additional information; ii) profile , where the agent is provided with the self-reported profile (gender, age, profession, etc.) of the user who produced the target comment; iii) behavior , where the agent is provided with the user’s behavioral traits; iv) behavior+r , same as behavior but including the extractor model’s reasoning; v) history , where the agent is provided with 5-20 comments by the same user (randomly sampled if more are available), enabling indirect conditioning through stylistic and behavioral patterns in prior contributions. The prompts for each method are provided in Appendix C , Figures 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 .
blocks.zh:
我们定义了五种调节方法
调查不同类型的人的信息如何塑造相互作用中的代理行为:(一) 基本角色扮演,其中代理被指示是维基百科编辑,没有附加信息;(二) 剖面图,其中代理被提供生成目标评论的用户的自我报告剖面图(性别,年龄,专业等); (三) 行为,其中代理被提供用户的行为特征;(四) 行为+r,与行为相同,但包括提取器模型的推理;(五) 历史,该代理被同一用户提供5-20个评论(如果有更多信息可用,则随机抽样),通过前期贡献中的形式和行为模式,实现间接调节. 附录C,图14、15、16、17提供了每种方法的提示。

blocks.en: We run experiments with four state-of-the-art models spanning both open-source and proprietary systems: Model A (proprietary), Model B, Model C, and Model D (open-weights). 9 9 9 Model identities are withheld; we report results under anonymized labels (Model A–Model D). All four are widely-used frontier LLMs at the top of their respective open-weights and proprietary classes at the time of writing, chosen to ensure that our findings reflect the behavior of strong, competitive systems rather than artifacts of weak models. Implementation and generation details are provided in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 我们用四种最先进的模型进行实验,包括开源和专有系统: 型号为A(专有),型号为B,型号为C,型号为D(开放重量级). 9 9 模型身份被扣;我们报告无名化标签的结果(模型A-模型D)。 在编写本报告时,这四家企业都是广泛使用的前沿有限责任公司,它们都是各自开放量级和专有类的顶级企业,其选择是为了确保我们的调查结果反映强大、竞争的系统的行为,而不是弱模型的文物。 执行情况和生成细节见附录E。

blocks.en: We report text similarity via ROUGE-L ( Lin, 2004 ) for surface lexical overlap and BERTScore ( Zhang et al., 2020 ) for semantic similarity, both raw and rescaled against a baseline (rBERT) as recommended. 10 10 10 https://github.com/Tiiiger/bert_score . Since generation is open-ended, these are coarse reference points rather than primary criteria.
blocks.zh: 根据建议,我们通过ROUGE-L(Lin,2004年)报告表层词汇重叠的文本相似性,而BERTScore(Zhang等人,2020年)报告语义相似性,包括原始语义相似性,并按照基线(rBERT)调整。 由于世代无限制,这些是粗糙的参考点,而不是首要标准。

blocks.en: Our primary focus is interactional behavior . We extract dialogue acts using the taxonomy of Ferschke et al. (2012) , developed for Wikipedia Talk pages, considering 10 acts: critique , request , reference , commit , report , inform , ask , positive , negative , and partial . 11 11 11 Mapping to Ferschke et al. (2012) is in Appendix F . Both human and agent comments are annotated with the extractor model as LLM annotator (prompt in Appendix C , Figure 12 ), which achieves 0.76 F1 against human judgment (Appendix F ). Each comment can carry one or multiple acts. We additionally assess overall response tone via sentiment prediction on both human and agent comments. 12 12 12 Using the multilingual model https://huggingface.co/tabularisai/multilingual-sentiment-analysis , predicting on a five-point scale from very negative to very positive .
blocks.zh: 我们的首要重点是互动行为。 我们利用为维基百科开发的Ferschke等人的分类学来提取对话行为(2012年) 谈话页,考虑10项行为:批评、请求、参考、承诺、报告、通报、询问、肯定、否定,以及部分对Ferschke等人的测绘(2012年)。 人类评论和代理人评论都附加了提取器模型作为LLM注释器(提示于附录C,图12)的注释,该注释根据人类判断(附录F)达到了0.76 F1. 每个评论可以包含一个或多个行为. 使用多语种模式https://huggingface.co/cutalisai/multiple-sentiment-analysis, 从非常负面到非常正面的五点范围预测。

blocks.en:
All metrics are computed at the dataset level. BERTScore and ROUGE-L are averaged over all output-reference pairs. Sentiment and dialogue act distributions are compared via Wasserstein Distance (WD; Panaretos and Zemel, 2019 ) and Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD; Menéndez et al., 1997 ), reflecting the ordinal nature of sentiment and the nominal nature of acts. This aggregate perspective targets population fidelity —whether agents collectively reproduce distributional behavioral tendencies—rather than individual-level persona fidelity.
ROUGE-L and BERTScore are computed at the instance level against each target user’s ground-truth response and then averaged across the dataset.
blocks.zh:
所有度量衡均按数据集水平计算。 BERTSCore和ROUGE-L在所有产出参考对中均值。 通过Wasserstein District(WD;Panaretos and Zemel, 2019)和Jensen-Shannon Divergence(JSD;Menéndez等人,1997年)比较了感官和对话行为分布,反映了情绪的正统性质和行为的名义性质. 这种总体观点针对的是人口的忠诚——无论是代理人集体复制分布行为倾向,而不是个人一级的人的忠诚。
ROUGE-L和BERTScore是按每个目标用户的地面实况反应在实例一级计算,然后在整个数据集进行平均计算。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Text Similarity
blocks.zh: 5.1 文本相似性

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows ROUGE-L and rBERT scores averaged across models and languages; full results, including average comment length and raw BERTScore (which remains stable across setups, ∼ 0.84 {\sim}0.84 – 0.85 0.85 , and is thus less informative), are in Appendix G , Tables 11 – 12 . While our primary target is population fidelity (Section 4 ), these instance-level metrics provide a complementary individual-level signal.
blocks.zh: 图2显示ROUGE-L和rBERT在模型和语言中的平均分数;全部结果,包括平均评论长度和原始的BERTScore(在各种设置之间保持稳定, ^ 0.84 {\sim}0.84 – 0.85 0.85, 因而资料较少)载于附录G表11 – 12。 虽然我们的首要目标是人口的忠诚(第4节),但这些实例一级的衡量标准提供了个人一级的补充信号。

blocks.en: ROUGE-L scores never exceed 0.154 0.154 . While low in absolute terms, this is expected given the open-ended nature of the task, where the space of plausible responses is virtually unbounded; scores are thus best read as relative measures. rBERT hovers around zero, indicating that agent-human similarity is broadly comparable to random sentence-human pairs, further confirming the difficulty of the task .
blocks.zh: ROUGE-L分数从未超过0.154 0.54 (英语). 虽然绝对值较低,但鉴于任务的开放式,似乎答复的空间几乎没有限制;因此,最好将分数视为相对衡量。 rBERT徘徊在零左右,表明物剂-人类相似性与随机的句子-人类对大致相当,进一步证实了任务的难度.

blocks.en: Figure 3: JSD between human and agent dialog act distributions across conditioning methods. Left: averages across models for each language. Right: averages across languages for each model.
blocks.zh: 图3: 人与代理对话之间的JSD 跨条件方法的行为分布. 左:每种语言的跨模型平均值. 对:每个模型的跨语言平均值。

blocks.en: Across both languages and models, history consistently yields the highest similarity, with ROUGE-L up to 0.154 0.154 (Model A in es ) and rBERT up to 0.105 0.105 (Model A in de ). behavior+r is the second most effective, with consistent gains over base (e.g., ROUGE-L up to 0.138 0.138 for Model A in es ; rBERT up to 0.085 0.085 for Model A in de ). By contrast, profile generally degrades similarity relative to base (e.g., rBERT drops on average from 0.053 0.053 to 0.040 0.040 for Model A, and from − 0.017 -0.017 to − 0.049 -0.049 for Model D), likely because prompting agents to reflect persona traits leads them to incorporate non-relevant details, producing longer and more elaborated responses without improving content alignment. Indeed, agent comments are consistently longer than human comments across all conditions (Appendix G ). behavior similarly fails to improve similarity for most models and languages, with only modest gains in some cases (e.g., Model B’s ROUGE-L from 0.078 0.078 to 0.082 0.082 ).
blocks.zh: 在两种语言和模式中,历史的相似度一直最高,ROUGE-L最高为0.154 0.154(模式A in es ),rBERT最高为0.105 0.105(模式A in de .)。 行为+r是第二有效,比基数有一致的增益(例如:ROUGE-L在 es 中最多为0.138 0138;rBERT在 e 中为 0.085 0.085). 相比之下,剖面通常会降低与基数的相似性(例如,模型A的rBERT平均从0.053 0.053降至0.040 0.040,模型D的 0.017 - 0.017 降至 0.049 - 0.049),这可能是因为促使代理人反映人物特征导致它们纳入无关的细节,产生更长和更细化的响应而不改进内容的一致. 事实上,在所有情况下,代理评论总是长于人类评论(附录G)。 行为同样未能改善大多数模型和语言的相似性,在某些情况下只有微小的增益(例如模型B的ROUGE-L从0.078 0.078到0.082 0.082).

blocks.en: Cross-lingually, ROUGE-L scores are consistently higher for es and en than for de and it , partially mirroring human comment length: longer reference texts provide richer surface for lexical overlap. rBERT trends are less pronounced; en falls slightly below the others, largely driven by Model B’s particularly low English scores.
blocks.zh: 在跨语言方面,ROUGE-L的得分在es和en方面一直高于de和de,部分反映了人类评论长度:较长的参考文本为词汇重叠提供了更丰富的表面. rBERT的趋势不太明显;en略低于其他趋势,主要受B型模式特别低的英语成绩驱动。

blocks.en: Overall, concrete demonstrations —through comment histories ( history ) or behavioral traits paired with reasoning ( behavior+r )— are more effective than abstract descriptions ( behavior ) and sociodemographic information ( profile ) at steering agent output toward human-like text. This is the dominant pattern across models and languages, while cross-lingual differences remain small , though we note that all five languages are high-resource and European. The consistency is nonetheless non-trivial given that they span two language families and differ in Wikipedia community size and editorial norms.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,具体演示——通过评论历史(历史)或行为特征与推理(行为+r)配对——比抽象描述(行为)和社会人口信息(剖面)在引导代理人输出向人文文本时更有效. 虽然我们注意到这五种语言都是高资源语言和欧洲语言, 但这种一致性是非部落性的,因为它们跨越两个语言家族,在维基百科社区规模和编辑规范上有所不同。

blocks.en: 5.2 Interaction Behavior
blocks.zh: 5.2 互动行为

blocks.en: Figure 4: Proportion difference between human and agent dialog acts. Positive values indicate human over-production; negative values indicate agent over-production. Differences are averaged across languages.
blocks.zh: 图4:人与代理对话行为的比例差异。 阳性值表示人类生产过度;阴性值表示物剂生产过度. 各语文的差异平均为差异。

blocks.zh: 图5:人类和代理人(历史下的A模式)的情绪得分分布

blocks.en: In the following we discuss evaluation of behavioral patterns through dialog act JSD and sentiment WD; detailed scores are reported in Appendix G , Tables 13 and 14 .
blocks.zh: 以下我们讨论通过对话行为JSD和情感WD对行为模式的评价;详细得分在附录G,表13和表14中报告。

blocks.en: Figure 3 presents average JSD scores aggregated across models (left) and languages (right). Scores range between 0.1 0.1 and 0.3 0.3 , indicating only moderate divergence between human and agent dialogue act distributions . history is the strongest method, achieving the lowest JSD overall ( 0.085 0.085 for Model A in en ). behavior+r is second, with consistent gains over base (e.g., Model B: 0.272 → 0.241 0.272\to 0.241 ; Model D: 0.199 → 0.166 0.199\to 0.166 ). By contrast, behavior is the weakest, increasing JSD across most models and languages (except Model B, where it improves over base , 0.272 → 0.245 0.272\to 0.245 ). profile yields only marginal effects, with gains limited to Model A ( 0.150 → 0.147 0.150\to 0.147 ). These trends are broadly consistent across languages, though en achieves the lowest average JSD throughout (e.g., 0.188 0.188 under base , 0.175 0.175 under behavior+r ), likely reflecting English-centric pretraining. Cross-lingual differences, however, remain marginal .
blocks.zh: 图3显示各模型(左)和语文(右)的JSD平均分数。 得分在0.1至0.3 0.3之间,仅表明人与物剂对话行为分布之间略有差异。 历史是最强的方法,总体实现最低的JSD(模型A in en 0.085 0.085). 行为+r是第二位,与基数相比有一致的增益(如型号B:0.272 → 0.241 0.272\to 0.241;型号D:0.199 → 0166 0.199\to 0166). 相比之下,行为是大多数模型和语言中最弱的,JSD的增加(除了模型B,它比基数改善,0.272~0.245 0.272\to 0.245). profile只产生边际效应,收益仅限于模型A(0.150~0.147 0.150\至0.147). 这些趋势在各种语言之间大体一致,尽管在整体上达到了最低的平均JSD(例如基数下0.1880.188,行为+r下0.1750.175),可能反映了以英语为中心的预训. 然而,各种语言之间的差别仍然很小。

blocks.en: Overall, these results reinforce the pattern observed for text similarity: concrete behavioral demonstrations ( history , behavior+r ) are consistently more effective than abstract descriptions or sociodemographic factors ( behavior , profile ) at aligning agent behavior with human distributions, echoing the well-established advantage of few-shot over zero-shot conditioning Brown et al. (2020) .
blocks.zh: 总体来说,这些结果强化了观察到的文本相似性的规律: 具体的行为表现(历史,行为+r)在将代理行为与人类分布相匹配时,比抽象描述或社会人口因素(行为,剖面)一致更有效,与零镜头配置Brown等人(2020年)的既定优势相呼应.

blocks.en: One might wonder whether this gap reflects a difference in information type or simply in information quantity , since history provides 5–20 raw comments while profile and behavior supply compressed summaries. We address this concern in Appendix H , where we show that performance under profile does not improve consistently with profile length: ROUGE-L and rBERT are flat, and where acts and sentiment JSD change, they mostly worsen with longer profiles. Combined with the observation that profile degrades performance relative to base despite adding tokens, this argues against a pure context-budget explanation and supports our interpretation that the operative factor is information type, not quantity.
blocks.zh: 人们可能会问,这一差距是反映了信息类型的差异,还是仅仅反映了信息数量的差异,因为历史提供了5-20个原始评论,而概况和行为提供了压缩摘要。 我们在附录H中论及了这一关切,其中我们表明,概况下的绩效没有随着概况长度的提高而得到一致的改善:ROUGE-L和 rBERT是平坦的,而如果行为和情绪发生变化,则随着较长的概况,它们大多会恶化。 加上虽然增加了符号,但剖面可以降低业绩,这与纯粹的上下文预算解释相反,并支持我们的解释,即执行因素是信息类型,而不是数量。

blocks.en: To assess whether divergences concentrate on specific labels, we analyze per-label proportion differences ( δ \delta ) between human and agent distributions, where positive values indicate human over-production and negative values indicate agent over-production. Figure 4 shows differences averaged across languages, omitting acts with negligible variation ( Ask , Critique , Positive , Partial ). Differences are computed between proportions rather than raw counts to account for lower act density in agent comments (Appendix G ). Full breakdowns are in Tables 13 – 14 .
blocks.zh: 为了评估差异是否集中在具体的标签上,我们分析了人与物剂分布的每个标签比例差异(\\\delta),其中的正值表明人的过量生产,负值表明物剂过量生产. 图4显示各语言之间平均差异,略去可忽略不计变化的行为(Ask, Critique, Buit , Part .)。 计算比例之间的差异,而不是原始数,以说明代理评论中行为密度较低(附录G)。 详细情况见表13至表14。

blocks.en: Agents systematically over-produce Request (up to δ = − 0.177 \delta=-0.177 for Model C in de on behavior ) and Commit (up to δ = − 0.108 \delta=-0.108 for Model D in fr on behavior ), while humans produce more Report ( δ = 0.088 \delta=0.088 for Model C in fr on behavior ). Together, this suggests that agents tend to operate by requesting and committing to changes, yet report fewer actions already undertaken. Inform is under-produced by agents across most models, possibly reflecting insufficient factual grounding (Model A and Model D diverge in some methods). Reference shows a model-dependent pattern. Negative is consistently under-produced ( δ \delta from 0.020 0.020 to 0.104 0.104 ), consistent with sycophantic tendencies of LLMs Malmqvist (2025) . Overall, the most systematic biases concern operativity (over-production of Request , Commit ) and negativity (under-production of Negative , Report ), pointing to a consistent tendency for agents to be more action-oriented and less confrontational than humans.
blocks.zh: 人员系统生产过多 请求(最多= = − 0.177\ delta=-0.177 for Model C in on activity )和提交(最多= = − 0.108\ delta=-0.108 for Model D in activity fr),而人类则制作更多的报告(= 0.088\ delta= 0.088 for Model C in fr on activity ). 两者合在一起表明,代理商往往要求并致力于变革,但报告已经采取的行动较少。 多数模型的代理人提供的信息不足,可能反映事实依据不足(一些方法的A模式和D模式不同)。 参考显示一个模型依赖的模式. 阴性一直生产不足( \\ delta从 0.020 0.020 到 0. 104 0. 104), 与 LLMs Malmqvist (2025) 的阴性倾向一致 。 总的来说,最系统性的偏见涉及操作性(过多地产生要求,提交)和消极性(消极性,报告),表明代理人比人类更注重行动,更不具有对抗性。

blocks.en: To examine whether agents reproduce dialog act trends equitably across genders, we analyze per-label proportion differences split by gender for two models with contrasting alignment levels (Model A, higher; Model B, lower) and two languages with similar contrast (English, higher; French, lower), under history (best overall), profile (the only method with explicit gender), and base as reference. Differences are shown in Appendix G , Figure 18 . Trends are consistent across genders for all labels and methods. Crucially, profile does not behave systematically differently from base or history , indicating that explicit gender conditioning neither amplifies nor reduces gender disparities in dialog act profiles .
blocks.zh: 为了审查代理人是否在两性之间公平地复制对话行为趋势,我们分析了两种模式的男女比例差异,两种模式的对应比(模式A,较高;模式B,较低)和两种语言的对比比(英语、较高;法语、较低),在历史(最佳总体)、概况(唯一有明确性别特征的方法)和基准下作为参考。 差异见附录G,图18。 所有标签和方法的性别趋势一致。 关键是,剖面与基础或历史没有系统性的区别,表明在对话行为剖面中,明确的性别条件既不扩大也不缩小性别差异。

blocks.en: Sentiment alignment broadly mirrors the dialog act trends: history yields the best alignment (minimum WD 0.097 0.097 for Model C in en ), followed by behavior+r ( 0.168 0.168 in en ). Across languages, en shows the lowest WD ( 0.315 0.315 on average under base ) and es the highest ( 0.452 0.452 ), consistently across methods. As shown in Figure 5 for Model A under history , agent responses rarely exhibit sentiment extremes ( very positive or very negative ) and contain fewer negative comments than humans, consistent with their lower rate of Negative acts. These patterns hold across models, conditioning methods, and languages (Appendix G , Figure 19 ). Overall, sentiment converges with the broader finding that agents tend to avoid negative or confrontational content across all conditioning methods .
blocks.zh: 感官调整大致反映了对话框行为趋势:历史产生最佳的调整(模型C在 en 中最少为 WD 0.097 0.097),其次是行为+r(0.168 0.168 in en ). 在各种语言中,最低的WD(基数下平均0.315,0.352)和最高的WD(0.452,0.452),始终采用各种方法。 如图5所示, 代理回复很少表现出情绪极端(非常正面或非常负面), 这些模式跨越模型、调节方法和语言(附录G,图19)。 总体来说,情绪与更广泛的结论一致,即代理人倾向于避免所有条件方法的负面或对抗内容。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced Wiki-Talkie, a multilingual dataset derived from Wikipedia Talk pages to evaluate agent interactions across five languages, using four state-of-the-art LLMs under different persona conditioning strategies.
Our evaluation targets population fidelity—whether agents collectively reproduce the distributional behavioral patterns of human communities—complemented by instance-level text similarity metrics.
Our experiments show that grounding agents with concrete comment examples consistently outperforms abstract persona descriptions across all languages. Notably, sociodemographic information can degrade agent performance, an encouraging finding for privacy-preserving applications. In addition, agents are consistently more action-oriented and less confrontational than humans, revealing a bias toward agreeableness and avoidance of extremes. Cross-lingual differences remain small, with English showing only slightly greater alignment.
Overall, these results underscore both the promise and limitations of persona-conditioned generation, motivating further research into more effective simulation strategies.
While we focused on next-turn generation to enable controlled comparison across a large experimental space, Wiki-Talkie is designed to support richer evaluation settings, including multi-turn generation, summarization, factual grounding assessment, and quality evaluation, all of which we encourage the community to explore.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了Wiki-Talkie, 一个来自维基百科Talk页面的多语言数据集,
我们的评估以人口的忠诚为目标——无论代理人是集体复制人类社区的分布行为模式——由实例一级的文本相似性衡量尺度加以补充。
我们的实验表明,有具体评论实例的地面探测剂在各种语言中的表现总是超过抽象的人格描述。 值得注意的是,社会人口信息可以降低物剂的性能,这是保护隐私应用程序的一个令人鼓舞的发现。 此外,与人类相比,代理人始终更注重行动,更不具有对抗性,显示出偏向于同意和避免极端。 跨语种差异仍然很小,英语显示的对齐性仅略高.
总的来说,这些结果突出了人造人的前途和局限性,促使进一步研究更有效的模拟战略。
虽然我们侧重于下一代,以便能够在大型实验空间进行有控制的比较,但Wiki-Talkie旨在支持更丰富的评价环境,包括多回合生成、总结、事实基础评估以及质量评价,我们鼓励社区探索所有这些。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Despite our multi-stage extraction and revision pipeline, some residual noise remains in Wiki-Talkie, including occasional misattributed comments, imperfect comment boundaries, and formatting artifacts not fully resolved during preprocessing
Such noise is inevitable at this scale and is unlikely to substantially affect evaluation or analysis.
blocks.zh:
尽管我们进行了多阶段的提取和修订,但维基语录中仍存在一些残留的噪音,包括偶尔出现错误的评语,不完善的评语边界,以及格式化的文物在预处理过程中没有完全解决.
在这种规模下,这种噪音是不可避免的,不太可能对评价或分析产生重大影响。

blocks.en: Wiki-Talkie currently covers five European languages (English, German, Spanish, French, and Italian), limiting its cultural and linguistic diversity. While these languages span two distinct families (Romance and Germanic) and vary in Wikipedia community size and editorial norms, they are all high-resource; findings may not generalize to language communities with different writing systems, discourse conventions, or editorial practices. Future work should extend Wiki-Talkie to additional languages, particularly those underrepresented in NLP research. The dataset construction pipeline and evaluation framework are fully language-agnostic and straightforwardly extensible to lower-resource and non-European languages.
blocks.zh: 维基语-塔尔基语目前涵盖5种欧洲语言(英语,德语,西班牙语,法语和意大利语),限制了其文化和语言的多样性. 虽然这些语言跨越两个不同的家庭(罗姆斯语和日耳曼语),在维基百科社区规模和编辑规范上也有所不同,但它们都是高资源;结论可能不会泛指有不同写作系统,讨论惯例或编辑惯例的语言社区. 今后的工作应当将Wiki-Talkie扩展至其他语言,特别是在NLP研究中代表性不足的语言. 数据集建设管道和评价框架完全具有语言不可知性,可直截了当地推广到资源较少和非欧洲语言。

blocks.en:
The richness and consistency of user personas vary considerably within and across languages. Some profiles contain detailed self-reported attributes, while others are sparse. English is generally better represented in both quantity and quality, meaning persona conditioning experiments may be more reliable for English than for other languages.
Moreover, despite subsampling to increase the representation of women and non-binary users, the dataset remains gender-skewed, which may affect the robustness of gender-based analyses.
blocks.zh:
使用者的丰富性和一致性在语言内部和语言之间差别很大。 一些剖面图包含详细的自报属性,而另一些则很少. 英文在数量和质量上一般都有较好的体现,也就是说,人性调节实验对英语来说可能比对其他语言来说更可靠.
此外,尽管进行子抽样以提高妇女和非二进制用户的任职比例,但数据集仍然是性别扭曲的,可能影响基于性别的分析的力度。

blocks.en: Our experiments focus exclusively on prompting-based persona conditioning, leaving alternative approaches to future work, such as fine-tuning (e.g., Thakur et al., 2024 ; Takayama et al., 2025 ), retrieval-augmented conditioning (e.g., Huang et al., 2023 ; Salemi et al., 2024 ), or embedding-based persona representations (e.g, Liu et al., 2025b ).
blocks.zh: 我们的实验完全侧重于促动性人格调节,为未来工作留下替代方法,如微调(如Thakur等人,2024年;Takayama等人,2025年);检索强化调节(如Huang等人,2023年;Salemi等人,2024年),或嵌入性人格表示(如Liu等人,2025年b)。

blocks.en: Our conditioning methods are not strictly matched on information density: history provides 5–20 raw comments, while profile and behavior supply compressed summaries. We probe this confound in Appendix H by stratifying profile performance by profile length and find no consistent improvement with profile length across four metrics, supporting an information-type rather than information-quantity interpretation. We did not perform the analogous analysis for history length because the conditioning pool is concentrated in the 16–20 comment range, leaving lower-comment buckets too sparse to support a meaningful comparison. A fully matched ablation—e.g., comparing history against equally long synthetic summaries distilled from the same comments—remains a direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们的调节方法在信息密度上并不严格匹配:历史提供了5–20个原始评论,而剖面和行为则提供压缩摘要. 我们通过按剖面长度划分剖面性能来探究附录H中这一混乱之处,并没有发现在剖面长度方面对四个度量的一致改进,支持信息类型而不是信息数量解释。 我们并没有对历史长度进行类似的分析,因为空调池集中在16-20个评论范围,使得低评论桶太少,无法支持有意义的比较。 完全吻合的提法——例如,将历史与从同一份评论中提炼出来的同样长的合成摘要进行比较——仍然是今后的工作方向。

blocks.en: Our profiles and behavioral traits are produced by a single anonymized extractor model and a specific prompting design. A manual audit (Appendix I ) indicates that these representations are largely faithful and well-grounded, with imprecisions limited to isolated factual details. Nonetheless, our findings about profile and behavior should be read as conclusions about sociodemographic and behavioral descriptors as we generated them , rather than as universal claims about all possible persona representations. Alternative summarization strategies, richer attribute schemas, or different extractor models could in principle yield different results.
blocks.zh: 我们的剖面和行为特征是由单一的无名化提取器模型和具体的提示设计产生的. 一项人工审计(附录一)表明,这些陈述基本上忠于职守,理由充分,不准确仅限于孤立的事实细节。 然而,我们有关概况和行为的结论应该被理解为关于社会人口学和行为描述的结论,而不应该被理解为关于所有可能的人物描述的普遍说法。 替代的归纳策略,丰富的属性计划,或不同的提取器模型,原则上可以产生不同的结果.

blocks.en:
Our primary evaluation target is population fidelity —whether agents collectively reproduce the distributional behavioral patterns observed in human discussions—rather than individual-level persona fidelity , i.e., whether each generated response faithfully reflects the specific persona provided. This choice is principled: individual-level fidelity risks enabling faithful simulation of specific individuals, raising ethical concerns around impersonation and lack of consent ( Desai et al., 2025 ) , while population fidelity is more tractable and more relevant for applications such as community simulation and policy analysis, in line with recent work advocating population-level evaluation of persona-based agents ( Mansour et al., 2025 ; Fawaz et al., 2026 ; Rupprecht et al., 2025 ) .
Assessing fine-grained individual-level persona consistency remains a direction for future work.
blocks.zh:
我们的首要评价目标是人口的忠诚——无论代理人是否集体复制了在人类讨论中观察到的分布行为模式——而不是个人一级的忠诚,即每个产生的响应是否忠实地反映了所提供的具体个人。 这一选择是原则性的:个人层面的忠诚有可能导致对具体个人进行忠实的模拟,引起关于冒充和缺乏同意的道德关切(Desai等人,2025年),而人口忠诚则更便于使用,更适用于社区模拟和政策分析等应用,符合最近倡导对以人为基础的代理人进行人口层面评价的工作(Mansour等人,2025年;Fawaz等人,2026年;Rupprecht等人,2025年)。
评估个人一级的一致性仍然是今后的工作方向。

blocks.en: Ethic Statement
blocks.zh: 道德声明

blocks.en: Privacy, Data Protection, and Contextual Integrity
blocks.zh: 隐私、数据保护和背景完整性

blocks.en: Wiki-Talkie is derived from Wikipedia dumps, released under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 license. While publicly accessible, we recognize that contributors may reasonably expect their comments to be archived for research purposes but not necessarily used for persona-conditioned simulation. Accordingly, we treat this dataset as human-derived data requiring safeguards beyond copyright compliance, guided by the principles of data minimization, proportionality, contextual integrity, and harm reduction.
blocks.zh: 维基百科中的相关条目: 維基共享資源中, 虽然可以公开查阅,但我们认识到,撰稿人可以合理地期望他们的评论为研究目的存档,但不一定用于人性化模拟。 因此,我们把这一数据集视为人类数据,在数据最小化、相称性、背景完整性和减少伤害等原则的指导下,需要超越遵守版权的保障措施。

blocks.en: The dataset does not contain original user pages verbatim. Instead, we generated neutral, natural-language re-elaborations summarizing publicly stated interests and interactional patterns, deliberately omitting usernames, real names, contact information, and external links. This process inherently introduces a layer of abstraction: the resulting profiles are approximate characterizations that may diverge from the original content through omission, rephrasing, or occasional inaccuracy. While this means profiles should not be treated as ground-truth descriptions of actual persons, we acknowledge that the same process may occasionally introduce erroneous attributes, including sensitive ones. We sought to mitigate this risk through manual inspection of a random sample of outputs (see Appendix I ).
blocks.zh: 该数据集不包含逐字的原始用户页. 相反,我们产生了中立的自然语言重构,总结了公开表达的利益和互动模式,故意省略用户名,真名,联系信息,以及外部链接. 这个过程内在地引入了一层抽象:由此产生的剖面图是近似特征,可能由于省略、重写或偶尔的不准确而与原始内容有所区别。 虽然这意味着不应将剖面描述视为对实际人物的地面真实描述,但我们承认,同一过程有时会引入错误属性,包括敏感属性。 我们力求通过人工检查随机抽取的产出来减轻这一风险(见附录一)。

blocks.en: Usernames are replaced using salted cryptographic hashing, where the salt is stored separately from the dataset and is accessible only to the principal investigator, preventing straightforward reversal or precomputation attacks (see Appendix A.2 ). Within comment text, we also anonymized mentions of third-party usernames to the extent possible. However, a residual risk remains where usernames appear in non-standard forms or where real names are mentioned in conversation.
blocks.zh: 用户名采用盐化密码散列法替换,将盐与数据集分开储存,只供主要调查员使用,防止直接逆转或预判攻击(见附录A.2)。 在评论文本中,我们也尽可能匿名提及第三方用户名。 但是,如果用户名以非标准形式出现,或者在谈话中提及真实姓名,则仍然存在剩余风险。

blocks.en: Complete anonymity cannot be guaranteed when working with public textual data. While salted hashing prevents trivial username reconstruction, a content-based re-identification risk exists: because Wikipedia discussions are publicly archived and indexed, motivated individuals could potentially identify original authors via distinctive phrases or search queries. Our dataset does not introduce new exposure beyond what is already publicly accessible, but we recognize that aggregation and structuring may lower the cost of such searches.
blocks.zh: 在使用公开的文本数据时,完全匿名是不能保证的。 虽然咸的散列可以防止微不足道的用户名重建,但基于内容的重新识别风险仍然存在:因为维基百科的讨论是公开存档和索引的,有动机的个人可以通过独特的短语或搜索查询来识别原始作者. 我们的数据集并没有在公众已可获取的范围之外引入新的曝光,但我们认识到,汇总和结构可降低此类搜索的成本。

blocks.en: To mitigate these risks, the dataset is released under the CC BY-SA 4.0 license, inherited from the underlying Wikipedia-derived content. Rather than hosting an open public mirror, we distribute it through a lightweight access request in which prospective users identify themselves and their intended use. This provides an audit trail and a point of contact while raising the effort required for indiscriminate bulk access. As a matter of research norms rather than a binding condition, we ask that recipients not attempt to de-anonymize contributors, not use the data to impersonate or manipulate editorial processes, and work from the most recent release.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻这些风险,该数据集在CC BY-SA 4.0许可下发布,从维基百科衍生内容中继承. 我们不是托管一个公开的公众镜像,而是通过一个轻量级访问请求来分发,预期的用户在其中表明自己和预期用途。 这提供了审计线索和联系点,同时加大了不分青红皂白的大规模准入所需的努力。 作为一个研究规范的问题,而不是一个有约束力的条件,我们要求接受者不要试图去名化贡献者,不要利用数据来冒充或操纵编辑过程,并且要从最近发布的版本中工作.

blocks.en: We provide a dedicated contact address for individuals who wish to request removal of their data. Upon verification, corresponding entries are added to a blocklist and removed in subsequent releases. Our goal is risk mitigation rather than elimination, and we consider the residual risk proportionate to the scientific value of studying collaborative online deliberation at scale.
blocks.zh: 我们向希望要求删除其数据的个人提供专门的联络地址。 经核实,相应条目被添加到块状列表中,并在随后的发布中移除. 我们的目标是减少风险,而不是消除风险,我们认为残余风险与大规模研究网上合作审议的科学价值相称。

blocks.en:
Individual informed consent was not sought, as contributions to Wikipedia are made under the CC BY-SA license and the Wikimedia Foundation’s Terms of Use, which explicitly permit reuse and derivative works. This is consistent with established practice in NLP research on Wikipedia-derived data ( Ferschke et al., 2012 ; Hua et al., 2018 ) , and the scale of contributors makes individual consent infeasible.
Nevertheless, we recognize that licensing permissibility does not fully resolve the ethical tension between contributors’ original communicative intent and downstream research applications; we address this gap through the layered safeguards described above.
blocks.zh:
没有征求个人的知情同意,因为根据CC BY-SA许可和维基媒体基金会的使用条款向维基百科提供捐款,明确允许再利用和衍生作品。 这与NLP研究维基百科衍生数据的既定做法是一致的(Ferschke等人,2012年;Hua等人,2018年),贡献者的规模使得个人同意不可行.
尽管如此,我们承认,许可性并不能完全解决贡献者最初的沟通意图与下游研究应用之间的道德矛盾;我们通过上述分层保障来解决这一差距。

blocks.en: Wikipedia Talk pages may occasionally contain harassment, conflictual exchanges, or incidental personal disclosures. We do not seek to amplify or foreground such content; the dataset is designed to analyze aggregate interaction patterns in collaborative environments, not for reputational analysis of specific contributors. We did not apply active content filtering in order to preserve the ecological validity of the discussions. Access restrictions are intended to further prevent misuse or amplification of harmful material.
blocks.zh: 维基百科 谈话页有时可能包含骚扰、冲突交流或偶然的个人披露。 我们并不寻求扩大或预测这些内容;数据集旨在分析协作环境中的综合互动模式,而不是用于对具体贡献者的声誉分析。 我们没有采用主动内容过滤来维护讨论的生态有效性。 限制接触是为了进一步防止滥用或扩大有害材料。

blocks.en: Experimental Ethics and Persona Conditioning
blocks.zh: 实验道德和人格条件

blocks.en: The objective of this research is not to recreate, approximate, or impersonate specific individuals. Persona-conditioned agents are stochastic constructs derived from coarse behavioral summaries, used solely to examine population-level dynamics in simulated group discussions. Although individual-level conditioning is methodologically necessary to capture heterogeneity in interaction styles, all evaluation and reporting are conducted at the aggregate level. We do not evaluate model fidelity to specific users, publish individual outputs, or claim to model the beliefs, intentions, or identities of real contributors.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的目的不是要重新创造、估计或冒充特定个人。 人性化剂(Persona-elected actors)是粗糙的行为总结衍生出来的结构结构,仅用于模拟小组讨论中考察人口层面的动态. 虽然个人层面的调制在方法上对于在互动风格中捕捉异质性是必要的,但所有评价和报告都是在总体层面进行的. 我们不评估对特定用户的忠诚模式,不公布个人产出,也不声称对真正的贡献者的信仰、意图或身份进行模拟。

blocks.en: We recognize that repurposing public discourse for AI research raises novel ethical questions concerning digital representation and contextual integrity. Our ethical justification rests on proportionality: the scientific value of understanding large-scale collaborative behavior, combined with layered safeguards (anonymization, profile re-elaboration, controlled access, opt-out mechanisms), outweighs the residual and mitigated risks.
blocks.zh: 我们认识到,重新利用公共言论进行大赦国际的研究,提出了有关数字代表性和背景完整性的新伦理问题。 我们的道德理由基于相称性:理解大规模协作行为的科学价值,加上分层次的保障措施(匿名、概况重新阐述、控制准入、选择退出机制),超过残余风险和减轻风险。

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows the distributions of the number of words per turn, turns per user, turns per thread, and users per thread across the five languages. These statistical properties exhibit remarkably consistent patterns across languages, suggesting that the conversational dynamics of the dataset are largely language-agnostic.
blocks.zh: 图6显示五种语言之间每转弯,每用户转弯,每线程,每线程的用户数分布. 这些统计属性显示出各语言之间明显一致的规律,表明数据集的对话动态基本上是语言不可知的。

blocks.en: The distribution is heavily right-skewed in every language, with the vast majority of turns containing fewer than 200 words, indicating that most conversational exchanges are brief while a small number of turns involve substantially longer responses. The 1,000-word cap applied uniformly across all languages, as threads containing longer turns were excluded due to their higher likelihood of noise.
blocks.zh: 每种语言的分布都高度右倾,绝大多数的转弯包含不到200个字,这表明大多数对话交流是短暂的,而少数转弯则涉及更长的响应. 1000字上限在所有语言中统一适用,因为包含较长转弯的线程由于噪音的可能性较高而被排除在外.

blocks.en: This distribution is similarly right-skewed, with most users contributing only a handful of turns. The bulk of users fall below 50 turns across all languages, with the long tail suggesting a small cohort of highly active participants. The Italian and Spanish subsets exhibit a narrower spread, consistent with the smaller number of threads collected for these languages.
blocks.zh: 这种发行方式同样是右侧扭曲的,大多数用户只贡献了少数转弯. 大部分用户在50人以下,跨越所有语言,长尾意味着少数参与者非常活跃。 意大利语和西班牙语子集的分布范围较窄,与为这些语言收集的线程数量较少相一致。

blocks.en: Threads are predominantly short, with the modal thread containing between 2 and 5 turns across all languages. This suggests that most conversations are transactional or goal-oriented rather than extended dialogues, with very few threads exceeding 10 turns.
blocks.zh: 线程主要是短的,其中模式线程包含2至5之间的线程,贯穿所有语言. 这表明,大多数对话都是以交易或目标为导向,而不是扩展式对话,很少的线程超过10个回合.

blocks.en: The vast majority of threads involve exactly 2 users, reflecting a typical dyadic conversation structure. Threads with 3 or more participants are rare across all languages, with the distribution dropping off sharply beyond 2 users.
blocks.zh: 绝大多数的线程都涉及精确的2个用户,反映了典型的dyadic对话结构. 在所有语言中,有3名或3名以上参与者的线索很少,分发量急剧下降,超过2个用户。

blocks.en: A.1.2 Users and Personas
blocks.zh: A.1.2 用户和人员

blocks.en:
In Table 2 , we show statistics on users and personas, with Figure 7 showing the corresponding word distributions for user pages and profiles. User pages are right-skewed across all languages, with most users having short pages and a minority producing substantially longer ones. Profiles follow a more bell-shaped distribution centered around 50–100 words, reflecting the relatively standardized length of the persona descriptions we construct from user metadata, and confirming that our persona extraction distills user information into concise, consistent summaries regardless of the underlying page length.
English users exhibit the richest descriptions, with both the longest average user pages and profile lengths (98.07 words), and near-complete coverage of contribution topics (100%), gender (67%), and profession (66%), reflecting the larger and more active English Wikipedia community. German users, while numerous, show lower rates of gender (36%) and profession (26%) disclosure despite high topic coverage (98.9%). Spanish, French, and Italian users display more modest attribute coverage, particularly for profession, reflecting sparser self-descriptions in these communities. The column reporting users with at least five turns indicates a core of highly active contributors in each language, ranging from approximately 30% (Spanish, Italian) to nearly 50% (German).
blocks.zh:
在表2中,我们显示用户和人的统计数字,图7显示用户页面和配置的相应字数分布。 用户的网页在所有语文中都是正确的,大多数用户的网页短,少数用户的网页长得多。 简介遵循一个比较钟形的分布,以50-100个字为中心,反映了我们从用户元数据中构建的人物描述的相对标准化长度,并证实我们的人物提取了用户信息,将用户信息分解成简明、一致的摘要,而不论基本的页面长度如何。
英文用户的描述最丰富,同时拥有最长的平均用户页和剖面长度(98.07字),以及几乎完全覆盖贡献话题(100%),性别(67%),职业(66%),反映了更大和更活跃的英语维基百科社区. 德国用户虽然人数众多,但显示性别(36%)和职业(26%)披露率较低,尽管专题覆盖率很高(98.9%)。 西班牙语、法语和意大利语使用者的属性覆盖率较低,特别是职业,反映了这些社区中人数较少的自我描述。 报告用户中至少有5个转弯的列表示每种语言都有高度活跃的贡献者的核心,从大约30%(西班牙语,意大利语)到近50%(德语)不等.

blocks.en: Figure 8 shows the proportion of non-deducible or, less frequently, malformed behavioral trait values across all users, broken down by trait and language. Agreement Strategy , Consensus Orientation , and Disagreement Strategy consistently account for the largest shares across all languages, possibly due to the lower frequency of these behavioral aspects in user comments. Notably, Spanish exhibits the highest proportion in Agreement Strategy ( ∼ \sim 0.50), while the remaining languages cluster more tightly around lower values. Traits such as Editing Behavior , Policy Usage , Tone Management , and Writing Style and Comment Structure show uniformly low proportions ( ≤ \leq 0.10) across all languages. Overall, cross-language variation is modest, with no language systematically underperforming across all traits.

blocks.en: A.2 Anonymization and Normalization
blocks.zh: A.2 匿名和正常化

blocks.en: All usernames in Wiki-Talkie are anonymized via deterministic hashing with a keyed hash function and salt, ensuring consistent mapping across the dataset while preventing reversal. Username occurrences are identified and replaced not only in structured metadata but also within comment text, where editors frequently mention one another through wikilink syntax or plain text references. 13 13 13 For risks associated with user re-identification, see Ethic Statement Section. Thread formatting is then cleaned and normalized: leading and trailing decorative characters (dashes, equals signs) are removed, HTML line breaks are converted to newlines, styling tags ( <div> , <span> , <u> ) are stripped while preserving content, <nowiki> and <code> tags are removed but enclosed text is retained, indentation markers are removed, and whitespace is collapsed and trimmed. MediaWiki templates and external links are preserved to maintain fidelity to the original discussions. The same normalization was applied also to articles.
blocks.zh: 维基百科中的所有用户名都通过定点散列函数和盐来匿名,确保了整个数据集的一致映射,同时防止逆转. 用户名的出现不仅在结构化的元数据中被识别和替换,在注释文本中,编辑经常通过wikilink语法或纯文本引用相互提及. 13 13 与用户重新识别相关的风险,参见Ethic语句部分. 线条格式化之后被清理和规范化: 引导和跟踪的装饰字符(dashes, 等号)被移除, HTML 换行符被转换为新线, 样式标记( <div >, <span >, <u >) 在保存内容时被剥离, <nowiki > 和 <code > 标记被删除但保留了附件的文字,缩进标记被删除,白空间崩溃并修剪. MediaWiki模板和外部链接被保存,以保持对原讨论的忠诚. 同样的正常化也适用于条款。

blocks.en: Appendix D Data Sample
blocks.zh: 附录D 数据样本

blocks.en: Table 3 reports statistics of the sampled data from Wiki-Talkie. English and French are the largest splits, with roughly 9–10k comments each. German, despite starting from the same number of initial threads (5,000), yielded fewer turns after subsampling. Spanish and Italian are roughly half the size of English and French. Thread length is consistent across languages, averaging around 3 previous comments per turn. All languages exhibit a strong male skew in user distribution, consistent with the well-documented gender gap in Wikipedia editorship Cabrera et al. (2018) . The skew is most pronounced in Italian and Spanish, where the limited pool of female editors made gender balancing impossible. English and French are the most balanced: in the French split, for instance, male and female editors contribute nearly equal numbers of sentences despite a skewed ratio of unique users.
blocks.zh: 表3报告来自维基-塔尔基的样本数据统计. 英语和法语是最大的拆分,各有大约9~10k的评论. 德语虽然从相同的初始线程(5,000)开始,但经过子采样后产生的转弯较少. 西班牙语和意大利语大约是英语和法语的一半。 各语文的线条长度一致,每转弯平均约有3个先前的评论. 与维基百科编辑Cabrera等人(2018年)中记录的性别差距一致, 在意大利语和西班牙语中,编辑人数最多,女编辑人数有限,无法实现性别均衡。 英文和法文是最平衡的:例如,在法文版中,尽管独特的使用者比例偏差,但男女编辑提供的句子几乎相等。

blocks.en: Appendix E Generation Details
blocks.zh: 附录 E 生成细节

blocks.en:
All next-turn generations were produced using a cloud-based batch inference service.
Generations were conducted with a temperature of 0 0 to ensure deterministic outputs, and a maximum of 1,024 1{,}024 tokens were generated per response.
To accommodate the context window constraints of each model, input prompts were dynamically truncated when necessary: if the combined length of the system and user prompts exceeded the available input budget (i.e., the model’s context window minus the reserved generation tokens), the article body was progressively shortened by iteratively reducing it to 90% of its current length until the prompt fit within the budget, with a <article_truncated> marker appended to signal the truncation.
For the history method, if the full history caused the prompt to exceed the context window, the number of historical threads was progressively reduced until the prompt fit; instances where the resulting history fell below the minimum threshold of 5 5 threads were flagged as underrepresented.
Prompts that could not be reduced to fit within the context window even after exhausting all truncation strategies were discarded.
blocks.zh:
后世各代均采用云母批量推论服务生产.
代数的温度为0,以确保确定性产出,每次响应最多产生1 024 1{ } 024令牌。
为了适应每个模型的上下文窗口限制,必要时会动态缩短输入提示:如果系统长度和用户提示的综合长度超过可用的输入预算(即模型上下文窗口减去预留的生成符),则文章正体通过反复缩短其当前长度的90%而逐渐缩短,直到迅速适应预算,并附有一个 " article_truncted " 标记,以示缩短。
就历史方法而言,如果整个历史导致迅速超过上下文窗口,则历史线条的数量将逐渐减少,直到迅速适应;如果由此产生的历史低于5个线条的最低阈值,则标注为代表性不足。
即使在用尽了所有的断线策略之后,仍无法减少以适合上下文窗口的提示被丢弃。

blocks.en: Appendix F Validation of Acts Annotation
blocks.zh: 附录F 行为的有效性

blocks.en:
To validate our LLM-based annotation approach, we rely on the SEWD dataset Ferschke et al. (2012) .
SEWD provides act annotations for English Wikipedia talk page discussions, a setting analogous to Wiki-Talkie corpus. In SEWD, the reconciled labels of two trained annotators serve as the gold standard. We use these reconciled labels to evaluate the quality of our LLM-as-annotator pipeline (the extractor model).
For clarity, we rename and merge some labels to reduce granularity; the full mapping is reported in Table 4 .
blocks.zh:
为了验证我们基于LLM的注释方法,我们依赖SEWD数据集Ferschke等人(2012年)。
SEWD提供英文维基百科谈话页面讨论的动作说明, 在SEWD,两个受过训练的注释员的和解标签是金本位。 我们使用这些调和的标签来评价我们的LLM-as-annotator管道的质量(提取器模型).
为明确起见,我们重新命名并合并了一些标签,以减少颗粒性;完整的绘图情况见表4。

blocks.en: However, the format of SEWD differs substantially from Wiki-Talkie. In SEWD, label spans are assigned directly to raw comments within a thread, without prior splitting or cleaning, whereas in our scenario we aim to provide the LLM with preceding comments as conversational context and a single target reply to be labelled. To bridge this gap, we first convert SEWD into the Wiki-Talkie format, structuring each instance as a target comment to be annotated along with its preceding comments as context, and aligning the corresponding SEWD labels. This conversion inevitably introduces noise; we therefore manually clean the resulting instances and discard those that could not be reliably mapped. From the original 1,500 threads in SEWD, this procedure yields 735 usable threads, which constitute our validation set.
blocks.zh: 然而,SEWD的格式与Wiki-Talkie大不相同. 在SEWD中,标签跨度被直接分配给线条内的原始评论,而不事先拆分或清理,而在我们的设想中,我们的目标是向LLM提供之前的评论作为对话上下文,以及一个需要标签的目标答复。 为了弥补这一差距,我们首先将SEWD转换为Wiki-Talkie格式,将每个实例作为目标注释与前述评论作为上下文附加说明,并调整相应的SEWD标签。 这种转换势必带来噪音;因此,我们手动清理所产生的情况,并丢弃那些无法可靠地绘制地图的情况。 从SEWD最初的1500条线程中,这个程序产生735条可用线程,构成我们的验证套.

blocks.en: Since replies in talk page discussions typically do not refer to much earlier context, we experiment with varying amounts of preceding conversational history: all previous comments, up to three, up to two, or only the immediately preceding comment. The prompt provided to the LLM includes explanations of each act label together with illustrative English examples drawn from SEWD. Table 5 reports the Micro-F1 and per-label F1 scores across these settings. Performance is stable across context windows, with the two-comment setting achieving the highest Micro-F1 (0.77). We therefore adopt this configuration for all subsequent annotation. Notably, these scores are very close to the human inter-annotator agreement reported in Ferschke et al., 2012 (Micro-F1 = 0.79), even though the two evaluation sets are not perfectly overlapping: ours is the product of format conversion and manual filtering, whereas the figure in Ferschke et al., 2012 results from cross-validation over the entire SEWD corpus. Nevertheless, this proximity strongly suggests that the LLM approximates human-level labeling quality.
blocks.zh: 由于在谈话页面讨论中的答复一般不提及更早的上下文,我们试验了不同程度的先前对话历史:所有先前的评论,最多3次,最多2次,或只是刚才的评论。 向LLM提供的提示包括每个行为标签的解释,以及从SEWD中提取的说明性英文实例。 表5报告这些设置的Micro-F1和每个标签的F1分数。 跨上下文窗口性能稳定,双评设置实现最高的Micro-F1(0.77). 因此,我们采用这一组合来作随后的所有说明。 值得注意的是,这些评分与Ferschke等人2012年(Micro-F1 = 0.79)报告的人类间评分协议非常接近,尽管这两套评分并非完全重叠:我们的评分是格式转换和人工过滤的产物,而Ferschke等人2012年的数字则来自整个SEWD的交叉验证。 然而,这种接近强烈地表明,LLM接近人类一级的标签质量。

blocks.en: Examining the per-label scores, the most challenging categories (F1 < < 0.70) are in order Partial , and Reference , Negative , Inform . To better understand these discrepancies, one of the authors of this paper manually inspected 20 instances per class where the LLM prediction and the ground truth disagreed. In more than half of the cases, the author judged the LLM label to be more appropriate than the gold label. This pattern may stem from a mismatch between how the act categories are explained in our prompt and how they were originally operationalized in Ferschke et al., 2012 (which is itself likely connected to the relatively low inter-annotator agreement reported in that work, arguably a consequence of insufficiently precise annotation guidelines).
blocks.zh: 检查每个标签的分数,最具有挑战性的类别(F1 < 0.70)按部分排列,参考,负数,通知。 为了更好地理解这些差异,本文作者之一手动检查了每类20个LLM预测和地面真相不一致的情况. 在超过半数的案件中,作者认为LLM标签比金色标签更合适. 这种模式可能源于我们迅速解释行为类别的方式与2012年Ferschke等人最初如何运作两者之间的不匹配(这本身可能与该工作中所报告的相对较低的通知人之间协议有关,可以说是说明准则不够精确的后果)。

blocks.en: Across all conditions, agent-generated comments are substantially longer than human comments. Human comments average approximately 48–78 words depending on the language ( de being the shortest at ∼ 48 {\sim}48 words and es the longest at ∼ 78 {\sim}78 ), while agent output consistently exceeds these figures, often by a wide margin. Notably, the history method yields the shortest agent comments across all models—for instance, Model A drops to ∼ 88 {\sim}88 words on average, its closest approximation to human length—suggesting that exposure to real interaction excerpts helps calibrate verbosity. Conversely, the behavior and profile methods tend to inflate output length, particularly for Model D and Model B. Interestingly, es also elicits slightly longer agent comments than other languages across all conditioning methods, mirroring the fact that human comments in es are themselves the longest.
blocks.zh: 在所有条件下,代理人产生的评论大大长于人类的评论。 根据语言的不同,人类评论平均约48-78个字(音节最短,48个字,78个字最长),而代理输出一直超过这些数字,往往差得很远。 值得注意的是,历史方法得出了所有模型中最短的代理评论——例如,模型A平均下降至\ 88 {sim}88字,它与人类长度的近似值——暗示接触真正的相互作用节选有助于校准动词。 反之,行为和剖面方法往往会拉长输出长度,尤其是对模型D和模型B. 有趣的是, es还引来比其他语言稍长的代理评论,

blocks.en: The act density ratio is consistently below 1.0 across all conditions, indicating that agent-generated comments are uniformly richer in communicative intents than their human counterparts. The lowest ratios are observed under the behavior method, where agents appear to enact the prescribed behavioral traits, which are dense in prescriptive interactional information. By contrast, when grounded with real examples via history , the ratio rises above 0.7 on average across all models and languages, with the exception of Model B, suggesting that concrete exemplars help bring act density closer to human levels.
blocks.zh: 在所有条件下,行为密度比率始终低于1.0,这表明代理人生成的评论在沟通意图上比人类对应的一致丰富。 在行为方法下观察到的最低比率,即物剂似乎具有规定的行为特征,而这些特征在指令性互动信息中是密集的。 对比之下,如果以历史中的真实例子为基础,除模式B外,所有模型和语言的平均比率都高于0.7,这表明具体实例有助于使行为密度更接近人类水平。

Appendix H Information Density vs. Information Type
blocks.zh: 附录H 信息密度与信息类型

blocks.en: A natural concern with our experimental design is that the comparison across conditioning methods may not be fully information-balanced: the history method receives 5–20 raw prior comments, whereas profile and behavior receive compressed summaries. Part of the gain observed under history could therefore reflect a larger context budget (i.e., information quantity ) rather than a strictly better form of persona representation, i.e., information type .
blocks.zh: 我们的实验设计所自然关心的是,跨条件方法的比较可能不能完全做到信息平衡:历史方法收到5–20个原始的前置评论,而剖面和行为则收到压缩摘要。 因此,在历史上观察到的部分收益可以反映更大的上下文预算(即信息数量),而不是严格来说更好的人物代表形式,即信息类型。

blocks.en: To probe this confound, we examine how performance varies with the amount of conditioning information provided. We focus this analysis on profile length, where the available token budget varies meaningfully across users (see Table 2 and Figure 7 ). For history , the analogous analysis would require comparing performance across different numbers of prior comments. However, the history sampler defaults to using up to 20 comments per user, and in practice the vast majority of conditioning pools fall in the 16–20 range; lower-comment buckets are too sparsely populated to support a meaningful comparison. We therefore restrict the analysis to profile length, which provides a well-distributed and interpretable proxy for input richness.
blocks.zh: 为了探究这种混乱,我们研究了性能如何与所提供的条件信息量不同。 我们把分析的重点放在剖面图长度上,因为可用的符号预算在不同用户之间差别很大(见表2和图7)。 就历史而言,类似的分析需要比较以前不同评论的绩效。 然而,历史采样器默认每个用户使用最多20条评论,实际上绝大多数的调压池在16–20的范围内;低调的桶子人烟稀少,无法支持有意义的比较. 因此,我们把分析限制在剖面长度上,它为输入丰富性提供了分布良好和可解释的代词.

blocks.en: We stratify all experimental instances by profile word count into five buckets (1–50, 51–100, 101–150, 151–200, 201–250) and compute, for each bucket and for each language–model pair, the four metrics used in our main analysis: ROUGE-L, rBERT, dialog act JSD, and sentiment JSD. Buckets with fewer than 20 samples are omitted, so de has no 201–250 bucket and es no 151–200 bucket. The es 201–250 bucket is dominated by a single user, who contributes 45 of its 67 samples, so its values should be read as largely individual rather than bucket-level. Results are shown in Figures 20 – 23 . The red dashed lines indicate the proportion of samples falling in each bucket; trends at the longest bucket should be interpreted with caution due to sample sparsity.
blocks.zh: 我们将所有实验实例按剖面词计算成五桶(1-50、51-100、101-150、151-200、201-250),并计算出每桶和每种语言的模范配对,这是我们主要分析中使用的四个标准:ROUGE-L、RBERT、对话行为JSD和情感JSD。 样本少于20个的桶被省略,因此没有201-250桶和151-200桶。 es 201–250桶由一个用户主导,该用户提供了67个样本中的45个,因此其值应被理解为主要是个人的,而不是桶级的. 结果见图20至图23。 红色的破折线表示每桶中样品落下的比例;由于样品的抽筋性,最长的桶的趋势应谨慎解释.

blocks.en: Across all 20 language–model pairs, none of the four metrics improves consistently as profile length grows. A pure context-budget account would predict a downward slope for JSD metrics (lower divergence = better alignment) and an upward slope for similarity metrics (higher = better) as more conditioning tokens are provided. ROUGE-L and rBERT are nearly horizontal in every configuration (within-pair ranges of at most 0.026 0.026 and 0.044 0.044 , respectively). Where the JSD metrics do move, they mostly move in the opposite direction: dialog act JSD rises for all four models in fr , mainly from the 151–200 bucket onward, and sentiment JSD rises with profile length for all four models in es , fr , and it . The few downward trends are small and confined to en and de : dialog act JSD for Model A in en decreases from 0.135 0.135 to 0.098 0.098 , and sentiment JSD decreases for some models in en and de , in en largely because of the sparse 1–50 bucket (under 3% of samples).
blocks.zh: 在所有20种语言模式的配对中,没有一种指标随着描述长度的增长而不断改进。 纯上下文预算账户将预测JSD指标的下坡率(较低差异=更好对齐)和类似指标的上坡率(较高=更好),因为提供了更多的调节符号。 ROUGE-L和 rBERT在每一种配置中几乎都是水平的(在平面范围内分别为0.026 0.026和0.044 0.044). JSD的衡量标准确实在移动,它们大多朝相反的方向移动:在fr中所有四个模型的对话动作JSD上升,主要来自151–200桶的前进,在es,f,以及它中所有四个模型的剖面长度上,JSD上升。 少数下降趋势很小,仅限于:模式A的对话行动JSD从0.135 0.135降至0.098 0.098,而某些模式的JSD情绪则下降,这主要是由于缺少1-50桶(低于样本的3%)。

blocks.en: Taken together, these results provide evidence against an information-density explanation for our main results. Together with the observation reported in the main text—that profile degrades performance relative to base despite adding tokens—this analysis supports our interpretation that information type , not information quantity , drives the differences across conditioning methods. We acknowledge that this analysis does not fully isolate every possible confound (e.g., compression-induced loss of stylistic exemplars), and we discuss this further in the Limitations.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,这些结果提供了证据,证明我们的主要结果没有资料密度。 与正文中所报告的观点(即尽管增加了符号,但剖面图还是比基数降低了性能)一起,这一分析支持了我们的解释,即信息类型,而不是信息数量,驱动了各种条件方法之间的差异。 我们承认,这一分析并不完全孤立所有可能出现的混乱(例如,压缩引起的文体学实例损失),我们在《限制》中进一步讨论了这一点。

blocks.en: Appendix I Qualitative Audit of Profiles and Behavioral Traits
blocks.zh: 附录一 对概况和行为特征进行定性审计

blocks.en:
Because profiles and behavioral traits are produced automatically by an LLM and then used as the key conditioning signals for profile , behavior , and behavior+r , their quality directly affects the interpretation of downstream results. To complement the quantitative analyses in the main text, we conducted a manual audit of these representations along three dimensions: (i) relevance and faithfulness of generated profiles with respect to the source user pages, (ii) coherence between assigned behavioral traits and the supporting reasoning produced by the extractor model, and (iii) privacy preservation , i.e., whether sensitive information (real names, usernames, contacts) is leaked into the generated representations.
We sampled 10 users per language (50 total) uniformly at random from the experimental subset and one of the authors inspected, for each user, the generated profile, all 8 behavioral traits with their reasoning, and the underlying user page.
blocks.zh:
由于剖面和行为特征由LLM自动生成,然后作为剖面,行为,和行为+r的关键条件信号,其质量直接影响到下游结果的解释. 为了补充正文中的定量分析,我们按三个方面对这些表述进行了人工审计:(一) 生成的描述与源用户页面的相关性和忠诚性,(二) 指定的行为特征与提取器模型产生的支持推理的一致性,以及(三) 隐私保护,即敏感信息(真名,用户名,联系人)是否泄露到生成的表述中.
我们从实验子集中随机抽取了每个语言的10个用户(50个总数),其中一位作者检查了每个用户生成的剖面图、所有8个行为特征及其推理以及基本的用户页。

blocks.en: In all 50 cases, profiles contain information that is relevant to and supported by the source user page. We identified a small number of imprecisions, none of which substantially distort the persona: • English: one numerical drift (“42 years” instead of “45 years”); one rounding error on edit count (“100,000” instead of “100,000k”); • French: one case where contributed-article information was omitted; • German: one case where the username was incorporated into the profile as if it were a separate entity, likely due to hallucination triggered by user page ambiguity; • Italian: one ungrammatical fragment (“Ha adottato il giorno 16 luglio e il comune di Plesio”) reflecting parsing ambiguity in the user page. We additionally observed that information from userboxes —small standardized templates that Wikipedia editors place on their user pages to declare interests, languages spoken, locations, or affiliations—is sometimes incorporated into the profile and sometimes ignored, with no clear pattern across languages. Moreover, we noticed that gender, when not explicitly self-declared, is typically inferred from gender-marked terms (especially in the four grammatical-gender languages: German, Spanish, French, and Italian) and, when available, from given names.
blocks.zh: 在所有50个案例中,配置文件都包含与源用户页面相关并得到其支持的信息。 我们查明了少数不准确之处,其中没有任何一个严重扭曲了人物:a 英语:一个数字漂移(“42年”而不是“45年”;编辑计数上的一个四舍五入错误(“100 000”而不是“100 000k”);法语:一个遗漏了贡献文章信息的案例;德语:一个用户名被并入档案,似乎是一个单独的实体,可能是由于用户网页模糊引起的幻觉;意大利语:一个不语法碎片(“Hadottato il giorno 16 luglio e il comune di Plesio”),反映了用户网页中的模糊性。 我们还注意到,用户箱中的信息——维基百科编辑在其用户网页上为宣布兴趣、语言、地点或隶属关系而设置的小型标准化模板——有时被纳入概况,有时被忽略,各语文之间没有明确的模式。 此外,我们注意到,性别如果没有明确自我宣布,一般是从性别标记术语(特别是在德语、西班牙语、法语和意大利语四种语法语言中)推断出来的,如果有的话,也可以从给定的名字中推断出来的。

blocks.en: For each of the 8 behavioral categories, we checked whether the assigned trait value is consistent with the accompanying reasoning. Out of 50 × 8 = 400 50\times 8=400 trait-reasoning pairs, in only 7 cases (across English, Spanish, and Italian) was the assigned label found to trace back to the provided reasoning. In most other cases, the reasoning explicitly cites concrete excerpts from the user’s comment history in support of the assigned trait, providing transparent grounding for the conditioning signal.

No real legal names, contact details, or other directly identifying information were leaked into the generated representations.

blocks.en: The audit indicates that the generated profiles and behavioral traits are largely faithful and well-grounded, with imprecisions concentrated at the level of isolated factual details rather than systematic distortions. This argues against an interpretation in which the relatively weak performance of profile and behavior is driven primarily by representation quality. At the same time, the audit highlights that profiles vary substantially in the kinds of information they emphasize (e.g., uneven uptake of userbox content) and that the compression step inherent in summarization may lose stylistic exemplars present in the raw history signal. In this sense, our results should be read as conclusions about the conditioning representations as we generated them , rather than as universal statements about all possible sociodemographic descriptors. We acknowledge this scope explicitly in the Limitations.
blocks.zh: 审计表明,生成的特征和行为特征基本上忠于职守,理由充分,不准确集中在孤立的事实细节层面,而不是系统的歪曲。 这不利于一种解释,即形象和行为表现相对薄弱主要取决于代表的质量。 同时,审计强调,概况在它们强调的信息种类上差异很大(例如,用户框内容的摄取不均衡),而汇总所固有的压缩步骤可能会失去原始历史信号中存在的风格化实例。 从这个意义上讲,我们的结果应被理解为关于我们所产生的条件性表述的结论,而不是关于所有可能的社会人口描述的普遍声明。 我们在《限制》中明确承认这一范围。
